package ssa

import (
	"IMPORT_ABI"
	IMPORT_BASE
	"IMPORT_IR"
	"IMPORT_OBJ"
	"IMPORT_SRC"
	"IMPORT_SYS"
	"IMPORT_TYPECHECK"
	"IMPORT_TYPES"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type snapshotDeadcodeFrontend struct {
	Frontend
	warnings []string
}

func (f *snapshotDeadcodeFrontend) Log() bool { return false }
func (f *snapshotDeadcodeFrontend) Fatalf(pos src.XPos, format string, args ...any) {
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", pos.Line(), fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)))
}
func (f *snapshotDeadcodeFrontend) Warnl(pos src.XPos, format string, args ...any) {
	f.warnings = append(f.warnings, fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", pos.Line(), fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)))
}

func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	target := struct {
		arch  string
		size  int
		order binary.ByteOrder
	}{os.Getenv("SYNCGO_TARGET"), 8, binary.LittleEndian}
	switch target.arch {
	case "386":
		target.size = 4
	case "mips":
		target.size = 4
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	case "ppc64":
		target.order = binary.BigEndian
	}
	SETUP
	ABI_SETUP
	var out []string
	add := func(label string, args ...any) { out = append(out, label+":"+fmt.Sprint(args...)) }
	trapped := func(label string, fn func()) {
		func() {
			defer func() {
				v := recover()
				if v == nil {
					t.Fatalf("%s did not fail", label)
				}
				add(label, v)
			}()
			fn()
		}()
	}
	file := src.NewFileBase("deadcode.go", "deadcode.go")
	position := func(line uint) src.XPos { return LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(file, line, 2)) }
	pos := position(10)

	cfg := &Config{PtrSize: int64(target.size), RegSize: int64(target.size), Types: *UP.NewTypes(), ctxt: LINK}
	fresh := func() (*Func, *snapshotDeadcodeFrontend) {
		fe := &snapshotDeadcodeFrontend{}
		cache := new(Cache)
		cache.Reset()
		f := cfg.NewFunc(fe, cache)
		f.Name = "deadcode"
		f.Type = TY.NewSignature(nil, nil, nil)
		f.ABISelf = ABI_NEW(0, 0, 0, 1)
		f.pass = &pass{name: "deadcode phase", stats: 3}
		f.Entry = f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
		f.Entry.Pos = pos
		return f, fe
	}
	dump := func(label string, f *Func) {
		for _, b := range f.Blocks {
			add(label+"-block", b.ID, " ", b.Kind, " ", b.Likely, " ", b.Preds, " ", b.Succs, " ", b.ControlValues())
			for _, v := range b.Values {
				add(label+"-value", v.ID, " ", v.Op, " ", v.Type, " ", v.AuxInt, " ", v.Aux, " ", v.Uses, " ", v.Args, " ", v.InCache, " ", v.Pos.Line(), " ", v.Pos.IsStmt())
			}
		}
	}
	check := func(f *Func) {
		uses := map[*Value]int32{}
		for _, b := range f.Blocks {
			for i, e := range b.Succs {
				back := e.b.Preds[e.i]
				if back.b != b || back.i != i {
					t.Fatal("reverse edge")
				}
			}
			for _, v := range b.ControlValues() {
				uses[v]++
			}
			for _, v := range b.Values {
				for _, a := range v.Args {
					uses[a]++
				}
			}
		}
		for _, b := range f.Blocks {
			for _, v := range b.Values {
				if uses[v] != v.Uses {
					t.Fatalf("%s uses=%d want=%d", v, v.Uses, uses[v])
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// A diamond with dead predecessors, a discarded BlockFirst edge and an unreachable loop.
	f, fe := fresh()
	e := f.Entry
	e.Reset(BlockIf)
	left, right, join, dead, loopA, loopB := f.NewBlock(BlockFirst), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockIf)
	e.AddEdgeTo(left)
	e.AddEdgeTo(right)
	left.AddEdgeTo(join)
	left.AddEdgeTo(loopA)
	right.AddEdgeTo(join)
	dead.AddEdgeTo(join)
	loopA.AddEdgeTo(loopB)
	loopB.AddEdgeTo(loopA)
	loopB.AddEdgeTo(join)
	for _, b := range f.Blocks {
		b.Pos = position(30)
	}
	it := cfg.Types.Int64
	ptr := TY.NewPtr(it)
	mem := e.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
	sp := e.NewValue0(pos, OpSP, cfg.Types.Uintptr)
	address := e.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, ptr, 8, sp)
	cond := f.ConstBool(cfg.Types.Bool, true)
	e.SetControl(cond)
	loopB.SetControl(cond)
	a, b := f.ConstInt64(it, 5), f.ConstInt64(it, 9)
	gone := left.NewValue2(position(15), OpAdd64, it, a, b)
	lv := left.NewValue2(position(15), OpSub64, it, b, a)
	right.NewValue2(position(18), OpNilCheck, ptr, address, mem)
	rv := right.NewValue2(position(19), OpAdd64, it, a, b)
	dv := dead.NewValue2(position(20), OpMul64, it, a, b)
	cycleA := loopA.NewValue2(pos, OpAdd64, it, a, b)
	cycleB := loopB.NewValue2(pos, OpMul64, it, cycleA, b)
	phi := join.NewValue4(position(21), OpPhi, it, lv, rv, dv, cycleB)
	store := join.NewValue3A(position(25), OpStore, TY.TypeMem, it, address, phi, mem)
	join.SetControl(store)
	blockGone := join.NewValue2(position(30), OpAdd64, it, a, b)
	unused := f.ConstInt64(it, 1001)
	local := GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos, TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("live"), it)
	local.Class = ir.PAUTO
	liveSlot, deadSlot := &LocalSlot{N: local, Type: it}, &LocalSlot{N: local, Type: it, Off: 8}
	f.Names = []*LocalSlot{liveSlot, deadSlot}
	f.NamedValues[*liveSlot] = []*Value{phi, phi, unused}
	f.NamedValues[*deadSlot] = []*Value{gone, unused}
	numberLines(f)
	dump("numbered", f)
	add("stats", fe.warnings)
	oldGoneID, oldBlockGoneID, oldUnusedID := gone.ID, blockGone.ID, unused.ID
	deadcode(f)
	check(f)
	dump("deadcode", f)
	add("names", len(f.Names), " ", f.NamedValues[*liveSlot], " ", f.NamedValues[*deadSlot])
	add("released", gone.Op, " ", gone.Block == nil, " ", blockGone.Block == nil, " ", unused.InCache, " ", unused.Block == nil, " ", oldGoneID, " ", oldBlockGoneID, " ", oldUnusedID)
	add("position-conserved", lv.Pos.IsStmt(), " ", join.Pos.IsStmt())
	add("cache", f.ConstInt64(it, 1001) == unused)
	var freeValues []ID
	for v := f.freeValues; v != nil; v = v.argstorage[0] {
		freeValues = append(freeValues, v.ID)
	}
	var freeBlocks []ID
	for b := f.freeBlocks; b != nil; b = b.succstorage[0].b {
		freeBlocks = append(freeBlocks, b.ID)
	}
	add("free-values", freeValues)
	add("free-blocks", freeBlocks)
	deadcode(f)
	check(f)
	dump("second-deadcode", f)
	// Removing one of two parallel edges updates the corresponding Phi position exactly.
	f, _ = fresh()
	e = f.Entry
	e.Reset(BlockFirst)
	join = f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
	join.Pos = pos
	e.AddEdgeTo(join)
	e.AddEdgeTo(join)
	a, b = f.ConstInt64(it, 1), f.ConstInt64(it, 2)
	mem = e.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
	sp = e.NewValue0(pos, OpSP, cfg.Types.Uintptr)
	address = e.NewValue1I(pos, OpOffPtr, ptr, 8, sp)
	phi = join.NewValue2(pos, OpPhi, it, a, b)
	store = join.NewValue3A(pos, OpStore, TY.TypeMem, it, address, phi, mem)
	join.SetControl(store)
	numberLines(f)
	deadcode(f)
	check(f)
	dump("parallel-edge", f)
	add("phi-copy-spliced", store.Args[1] == a)
	// Empty blocks, loops, multiple files and explicitly non-statement positions.
	f, fe = fresh()
	e = f.Entry
	e.Reset(BlockPlain)
	empty, head, body, exit := f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockIf), f.NewBlock(BlockPlain), f.NewBlock(BlockRet)
	e.AddEdgeTo(empty)
	empty.AddEdgeTo(head)
	head.AddEdgeTo(body)
	head.AddEdgeTo(exit)
	body.AddEdgeTo(head)
	other := LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("other.go", "other.go"), 71, 3))
	e.Pos = position(11)
	empty.Pos = pos.WithNotStmt()
	head.Pos = position(22)
	body.Pos = other
	exit.Pos = position(40)
	mem = e.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
	cond = f.ConstBool(cfg.Types.Bool, true)
	head.SetControl(cond)
	exit.SetControl(mem)
	a = f.ConstInt64(it, 1)
	body.NewValue2(other, OpAdd64, it, a, a)
	body.NewValue0(position(32).WithNotStmt(), OpUnknown, it)
	numberLines(f)
	dump("loop-numbered", f)
	add("loop-stats", fe.warnings)
	deadcode(f)
	check(f)
	dump("loop-deadcode", f)
	// Preserve a native failure on an artificial unreachable Copy cycle.
	f, _ = fresh()
	mem = f.Entry.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
	f.Entry.SetControl(mem)
	dead = f.NewBlock(BlockPlain)
	dead.AddEdgeTo(dead)
	cycleA = dead.NewValue0(pos, OpCopy, it)
	cycleB = dead.NewValue1(pos, OpCopy, it, cycleA)
	cycleA.AddArg(cycleB)
	numberLines(f)
	trapped("unreachable-copy-cycle", func() { deadcode(f) })
	dump("copy-cycle-failure-state", f)
	// Deadcode explicitly rejects post-register-allocation input before mutation.
	f, _ = fresh()
	mem = f.Entry.NewValue0(pos, OpInitMem, TY.TypeMem)
	f.Entry.SetControl(mem)
	numberLines(f)
	f.RegAlloc = make([]Location, f.NumValues())
	trapped("after-regalloc", func() { deadcode(f) })
	dump("rejected-unchanged", f)
	for _, op := range []Op{OpAddr, OpPhi, OpConst64, OpCopy, OpAdd64, OpLoad, OpNilCheck, OpArgIntReg} {
		add("statement-op", op, " ", isPoorStatementOp(op), " ", notStmtBoundary(op))
	}
	var _ ir.Node
	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR=" + string(data))
}
